dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "*sigh* How time flies... In the blink of an eye, I've grown old... Ah! Hello darling, come to Grandma... Ooh! Goodness, someone's growing up fast aren't they? You're not a small child anymore!"

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Now, what do you think this might be? Haha, it's a family heirloom. Grandma's ancestors brought it with them when they came here many years ago. Today, Grandma is giving it to you. Take it, and remember this nursery rhyme..."
